_comment: A lord's commission (docs/LIVING_WORLD_2.md §8): weight 0, so no board posts it; offered by rank in the lord's or steward's conversation and bound to the domain's real state by the 'commission' block (quest/commission/Binder).

title: A feud between two houses
Bad blood
Peace between the houses
summary: Two houses of the domain are at each other's throats. Hear out the head of each, in his lordship's name, and bring them to peace.
A feud festers between two families. Speak with both heads and settle it before blood is spilt.
His lordship wants an end to a quarrel between two houses: hear both, and let them know the court is listening.
offer: There is bad blood between two houses, and his lordship will not have a feud in his domain. Hear both heads of family, and make them understand.
Two families, one quarrel, and every week it grows. Speak with both. They will listen to the lord's sworn man.
Settle this feud for me. Go to both houses; hear them out; tell them the court will judge if they cannot keep the peace.
progress: Is there peace between them yet?
complete: Both heard, and both quieter for it. His lordship thanks you.
Peace, for now. That is more than anyone else managed.
Settled. A feud ended is worth a battle won.
